title: Japanese: JLPT N5 Core Vocabulary
description: For beginning Japanese learners: kana vocabulary, romaji, English meanings, and simple examples for N5-level study. A practical selection, not an official JLPT vocabulary list.

sources.name: Japan Foundation Irodori: Japanese for Life in Japan
sources.license: Copyright Japan Foundation; reference only, original entries
